theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intros P_i f_i f_ip1 nc P_ip1 y
  let fib := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y := y)
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hd : (fib 1 : L) = (fib 0 : L) + 1 := by
    let ii : Fin r := ⟨i, by omega⟩
    have hii : (ii : ℕ) < ℓ + 𝓡 := by show (i : ℕ) < ℓ + 𝓡; omega
    let jj : Fin r := ⟨↑i + 1, by omega⟩
    let b₀ : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ii :=
      sDomain_basis 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii hii ⟨0, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hii⟩
    let z : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ii :=
      sDomain.lift 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ii) (j := jj) (h_j := h_i_succ_lt)
        (h_le := Nat.le_add_right (i : ℕ) 1) y
    have c₀ : fib 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) • b₀ + z := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have c₁ : fib 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) • b₀ + z := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb : (b₀ : L) = 1 := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii hii
    have h1 : (fib 1 : L) = (b₀ : L) + (z : L) := by rw [c₁, one_smul]; rfl
    have h0 : (fib 0 : L) = (z : L) := by rw [c₀, zero_smul, zero_add]
    rw [h1, h0, hb]
    ring
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fib k : L) = (y : L) := by
    have h1 : y = iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (k := 1) (h_bound := by omega) (fib k) :=
      generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega) (fib k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h2 := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fib k)
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val (h1.trans h2)).symm
  have hsp (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fib k : L) = P₀.eval (y : L) + (fib k : L) * P₁.eval (y : L) := by
    rw [show P_i = P₀.comp (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩) +
        Polynomial.X * P₁.comp (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩) from
        evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp,
      hq k]
  have hA : f_ip1 y = P_i.eval (fib 0 : L) * ((1 - r_chal) * (fib 1 : L) - r_chal) +
      P_i.eval (fib 1 : L) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fib 0 : L)) := by
    dsimp only [f_ip1, Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold, f_i]
  have hcalc : f_ip1 y = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval (y : L) + r_chal * P₁.eval (y : L) := by
    rw [hA, hsp 0, hsp 1, hd]
    ring
  have he : (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval (y : L) + r_chal * P₁.eval (y : L) = P_ip1.eval (y : L) := by
    dsimp only [P_ip1, P₀, P₁]
    simp only [intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, nc,
      Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, Finset.mul_sum,
      ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    ring
  exact hcalc.trans he
